# Infer by Flow7

Use `infer/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "infer-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "infer/infer/gpt-5.6-sol:official",
});
```

## Environment variables

- `INFER_API_KEY`

## Provider package

`@ai-sdk/openai`

## Default base URL

`https://infer.flow7.org/v1`

You can override the base URL by setting `INFER_BASE_URL`.
